title: Ideal trigonal angle
statement:
What are the ideal F–B–F angles in BF₃?

[_]{a}

explanations: This is the tetrahedral reference angle.
This commonly appears in an octahedral arrangement.
This would put only two directions opposite each other.

hints: There are three domains around B.
Equal spacing in a plane divides 360° into thirds.
solution: There are three domains around B. All three are bonding directions. Equal spacing in a plane divides 360° into thirds. The geometry is trigonal planar.
